description: Address lookup for Ethereum and Base 0x addresses and XRPL r-addresses, auto-detected. Params: address (EVM 0x address or XRPL classic r-address, required); chain (optional EVM history hint: base default, or ethereum). Detects EVM vs XRPL from the format. Returns one normalized envelope: { address, chain, chain_detected, exists, risk_score, risk_level, verdict, flags, entity, name }. Free. For a fast first-pass check on a counterparty wallet.

address.description: EVM 0x address or XRPL classic r-address. Required.

chain.description: Optional EVM history hint. Default base.

name: lookup_wallet
